description: Request for an Environmental Impact Assessment Scoping Opinion under Regulation 15 of the Town and Country Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 2017 (as amended) comprising a 100,000 sqm Gross External Area (GEA) data centre with ancillary offices, internal plant, and substations, alongside up to 10,000 sqm GEA of mixed-use space including Use Classes E(g)(i-iii), B2, B8, and F2(a-c). The scheme includes varied massing across the site, ranging from the retained Stone Foundry at 17 m AOD and an SME building at 22 m AOD, up to an office building at 32 m AOD, a data centre with a maximum of 45 m AOD.
site_name: Land adjacent to and including the former Stone Foundries, 669A Woolwich Road and the VIP Industrial Estate, Charlton, London, SE7 8SL
